demo.title: taskmarket-safe-workflow.sh
demo.code:
# Browse without spending
taskmarket task list --status open --mode bounty --reward-min 1 --limit 20

# From the installed skill directory, inspect the live record with the read-only guard
taskmarket task get <taskId> | node scripts/taskmarket-guard.mjs inspect -

# After completing and verifying the brief, re-fetch and submit exactly once
taskmarket task get <taskId>
taskmarket task submit <taskId> --file deliverable.md --role final

setup: Reuse the intended keystore and verify it with `taskmarket address` and `taskmarket wallet balance`
Run `taskmarket legal status`; review and explicitly accept the current bundle before the first marketplace write
Inspect each live task and its `pendingActions` before any paid or consequential operation
